finding.headline: "Informal-Sector / Trader Self-Enrolment" (NHIA)
finding.problem: "I'm not working for a company so I thought insurance wasn't for me. But my baby's bills are killing me."
finding.person: Self-employed Nigerian mum (trader, artisan, freelancer) who doesn't qualify for employer NHIS and doesn't know she can self-enrol via HMO/state scheme (Lagos).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (NHIA Self-Enrolment for Informal Mums) / Standalone.". Verdict: PASSES.
